ios.desc:
Your iPhone may already be unlocked, but your private content does not have to be.

iLockBox is a private Photo Vault that helps protect your photos, videos, files, documents, and notes with Face ID, Touch ID, or a private PIN. Your personal content remains protected on your device, and no account is required for core privacy features.

PHOTO AND VIDEO VAULT

Keep personal photos and videos inside a protected private vault.

- Secure access with Face ID, Touch ID, or PIN
- Create private albums and folders
- Preserve original photo and video quality
- Organize your media with an easy-to-use interface
- Import only the photos and videos you select using Apple’s system photo picker

Whether you are protecting family memories, travel photos, important documents, or personal media, you remain in control.

LOCK SCREEN CUSTOMIZATION

Personalize how you access your vault.

- Choose from multiple lock screen styles
- Select custom app icons
- Follow clear instructions for each lock screen
- Use a consistent experience across iPhone and iPad

FOCUS

Use Apple’s Screen Time controls to manage access to selected apps during Focus sessions.

- Choose apps for each Focus profile
- Create and manage multiple Focus profiles
- Start or stop a Focus session at any time
- Control selected apps using authorized Screen Time access

Screen Time access is optional and is requested only when you choose to use Focus.

SECURE FILE STORAGE

Keep important files and documents inside your private vault.

- PDFs and documents
- Personal records
- Identification documents
- Organized folders
- Imported files from the Files app

PRIVATE NOTES

Store reminders, confidential notes, passwords, and other personal information in one protected location.

ADVANCED PRIVACY FEATURES

Privacy controls designed for everyday use.

- Intruder Selfie records unauthorized access attempts when enabled
- Quick Exit immediately leaves sensitive content
- Flip to Lock automatically secures your vault
- Album Protection adds another layer of security to selected albums
- Two-Step Authentication combines biometric verification with your private PIN

PRIVATE BROWSER

Browse privately and download supported files directly into your vault. Browsing activity remains separate from your everyday browser history.

BACKUP AND RESTORE

Create protected backups of your photos, videos, files, albums, and notes. Restore your content when needed.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY PRIVACY

Use iLockBox to:

- Protect personal photos
